downloads.title: Downloads
settings.downloads.hint: Download folder, queue limits, automatic downloads of new episodes and the local library.
downloads.empty.active.title: Nothing downloading
downloads.empty.active.body: Queue episodes from a title page (Download) or from the player.
downloads.empty.history.title: No finished downloads yet
downloads.empty.history.body: Finished, failed and cancelled downloads show up here with their date.
downloads.empty.anime.title: No episodes downloaded
downloads.empty.anime.body: Downloaded episodes and kept torrents show up here.
downloads.empty.manga.title: No manga chapters
downloads.empty.manga.body: Select chapters on a manga page and download them to read offline.
downloads.empty.novels.title: No novel chapters
downloads.empty.novels.body: Download chapters on a novel page to read them offline.
downloads.empty.local.title: Local library
downloads.empty.local.body: Video files you imported or scanned.
downloads.cancel.title: Cancel this download?
downloads.cancel.body: The partial data is deleted and the row leaves the queue.
downloads.remove.title: Remove from Downloads?
downloads.remove.body: The row leaves the list. Turn on the switch to delete the file too.
downloads.delete_files: Also delete the file from disk
downloads.verify.broken: The file is missing or truncated: download it again or remove it
downloads.broken.body: The file is missing or truncated. Download it again or remove it from the library.
downloads.history.clear_body: Finished, failed and cancelled rows leave the list. Files on disk stay.
downloads.storage.error: Could not read the disk use
downloads.storage.reached: Storage limit reached: automatic downloads are paused until space is freed or the limit is raised.
downloads.local.error: Could not load the local library
downloads.local.empty.title: The local library is empty
downloads.local.empty.body: Import video files or scan a folder: the release name is used to find the series and episode.
downloads.local.scan_hint: Empty = the library folders of Settings > Downloads
downloads.local.unmatched: {n} files could not be matched: use Match on them
downloads.local.unmatched.one: {n} file could not be matched: use Match on it
downloads.local.match_empty: No series found: try another name
downloads.local.remove.title: Remove from the local library?
downloads.local.remove.body: The file leaves the library. Turn on the switch to delete it from disk too.
downloads.season.title: Download episodes
downloads.season.empty: This title has no episodes to download
downloads.season.fallback: The episode list is not available; the numbers come from the episode count.
downloads.season.auto_hint: For the series in your Watching list, with the profile of Settings > Downloads
downloads.player.failed: The episode could not be queued
settings.downloads.dir_hint: Episodes and chapters go here (the torrent client keeps its own folder).
settings.downloads.concurrent_hint: How many episodes download in parallel.
settings.downloads.speed_hint: KiB/s for the whole queue; 0 = unlimited.
settings.downloads.limit_hint: GiB for downloaded episodes; 0 = none. At the limit automatic downloads stop and watched episodes are deleted first.
settings.downloads.delete_watched_hint: Downloaded episodes you finished are deleted after this many days.
settings.downloads.server_hint: Extension used first for new downloads.
settings.downloads.audio_hint: Audio language picked first for new downloads.
settings.downloads.auto_hint: New episodes of the series in your Watching list download by themselves while the app is open.
settings.downloads.profile_hint: Best available, balanced (up to 1080p) or data saver (up to 720p).
settings.downloads.interval_hint: How often new episodes are looked for.
settings.downloads.sim_empty: Nothing new would be downloaded right now
settings.downloads.library_hint: Scanned into Downloads > Local library and watched for new files.
